shortDescription: Module for setup of SystemConfiguration Avi RESTful Object

options.name: admin_auth_configuration
options.description: Adminauthconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: default_license_tier
options.description: Specifies the default license tier which would be used by new clouds. Enum options - ENTERPRISE_16, ENTERPRISE_18. Field introduced in 17.2.5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as ENTERPRISE_18.

options.name: dns_configuration
options.description: Dnsconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: dns_virtualservice_refs
options.description: Dns virtualservices hosting fqdn records for applications across avi vantage. If no virtualservices are provided, avi vantage will provide dns services for configured applications. Switching back to avi vantage from dns virtualservices is not allowed. It is a reference to an object of type virtualservice.

options.name: docker_mode
options.description: Boolean flag to set docker_mode. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: email_configuration
options.description: Emailconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: global_tenant_config
options.description: Tenantconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: linux_configuration
options.description: Linuxconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: mgmt_ip_access_control
options.description: Configure ip access control for controller to restrict open access.

options.name: ntp_configuration
options.description: Ntpconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: portal_configuration
options.description: Portalconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: proxy_configuration
options.description: Proxyconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: secure_channel_configuration
options.description: Configure secure channel properties. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1.

options.name: snmp_configuration
options.description: Snmpconfiguration settings for systemconfiguration.

options.name: ssh_ciphers
options.description: Allowed ciphers list for ssh to the management interface on the controller and service engines. If this is not specified, all the default ciphers are allowed.

options.name: ssh_hmacs
options.description: Allowed hmac list for ssh to the management interface on the controller and service engines. If this is not specified, all the default hmacs are allowed.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.

options.name: welcome_workflow_complete
options.description: This flag is set once the initial controller setup workflow is complete. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.
